contract: Validate-only, read-only, and sensitive updates do not change stored values. Describe omits sensitive values.
Incremental set, append, and subtract persist as one resource record and replay after reopen.
In-flight task and budget counters are unchanged by alter.
limits: This is not the DescribeConfigs, AlterConfigs, or IncrementalAlterConfigs RPC.
The schema is a fixed topic and broker subset, not the full Kafka config definition.
The journal format is the local PLCONF01 record.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
